intro: Revelation is the last book of the Bible: a vision given to John, exiled on the island of Patmos. It begins with a blessing on everyone who reads it, and everyone who hears it.
Chapters one to three: the risen Jesus speaks to seven churches. Chapters four to twenty: visions of God's throne, the Lamb, and the long battle between good and evil, told in vivid pictures.
Chapters twenty-one and twenty-two: a new heaven and a new earth, where God shall wipe away all tears.
Tradition holds that the apostle John wrote it.
It's full of symbols, and Christians read them in different ways. Listen for the big picture: the Lamb wins, and God makes all things new.
